propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate trained the next-best-check recommendation model and evaluated it offline against the previous rule set.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the training and evaluation directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate coordinated releases with the platform and compliance teams, with compliance signing the change record and the platform lead approving the rollout window.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the coordination and the approval boundaries.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate deployed model versions 2.3 and 2.4 to production and operated the model in production, including a rollback of version 2.4.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the incident log entry and the reference call state the production deployment role, the canary rollouts and the rollback.

expectedGap: Hand-over conditions for each model version are only partly documented; the model card covers limitations but not hand-over.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the production deployment and operation as documented for versions 2.3 and 2.4; do not extend it to other services or to model versions the materials do not name.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask how hand-over conditions were documented for each model version.
